## Investigation findings

**Summary:** One root cause, in `ts-travel-service`. Its `GET /api/v1/travelservice/routes/{tripId}` handler (`TravelController.getRouteByTripId`) fails on every request starting at about 16:27:24 on 2025-08-20. The failures propagate upstream through `ts-food-service` and `ts-route-plan-service` to `ts-travel-plan-service`, then to `ts-ui-dashboard` and the load generator. I found no independent second fault.

### Affected endpoints and services (abnormal vs. normal)

| Service | Abnormal | Normal | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
